worldcombat.skill.superpower.summary: Lowers its shoulder, then drives low into the foe for one heavy physical blow that leaves a short-lived crater; after it lands the user's Attack and Defense both drop. The shock-wave form adds an aftershock ring and a bigger crater at the cost of one more Defense stage and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.0: Open with the single heaviest hit up close
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.1: Knock a foe out of position and leave a dent in the ground
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.2: Shock-wave form to blast a cluster gathered at the impact point
worldcombat.skill.superpower.description: Drives into the foe for %1$s physical damage and knocks it %2$s blocks along the impact line.
Charge range %1$s blocks; on a hit the user's Attack drops %2$s stage(s) and Defense drops %3$s.
Takes %1$s s to sink the weight in, then charges flat at %2$s blocks/tick.
Shock-wave form: the impact point rings out %1$s blocks, blasting nearby foes for %2$s power and carving a larger crater; the user's Defense drops one more stage.
Focused form: all force goes into one target, casts faster and only drops the native one stage of Attack and Defense, but reaches no one else.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the knock-back to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.growth.1: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the charge range to %3$s blocks.
On: the impact point rings out an aftershock, blasting nearby foes and carving a larger crater; costs one more Defense stage, impact power x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +4 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (focused): all force into one target, faster cast, only the native single stage drop.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the charge from farther, but it is easier to sidestep mid-charge.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one heavy single hit finishes them before the price is paid; off: all targets score the same.
Below this own health ratio the user holds Superpower back (0 = no limit). Higher makes it save the hit for a worthwhile trade.
